BAD-Collatz

I am fascinated by the Collatz Conjecture, I also think its a decent tool for learning a new programing language. Break it down into separate functions, mess around with string manipulation, basic mathematical operations, and looping logic. This version is more primitive than what i might make now, but its still a nice lookback.
n +
n /
Integers only. Tests one case of N.
Put 0 in 'Max Loops' for infinite loops.
